```mcstas
# McStas instrument file for improved collimation of a SANS instrument

# Define the instrument
instrument t2_sans_collimation_improved

# Set global parameters
set seed = 123456789
set ncount = 1e6
set gravity = true

# Source component
source Source
  type = Source_pure
  lambda0 = 6.0
  lambda = 6.0
  lambda_width = 0.05
  lambda_min = 5.95
  lambda_max = 6.05
  intensity = 1e10
  direction = (0,0,1)
  position = (0,0,0)
  rotation = (0,0,0)
end

# First pinhole collimator
collimator Pinhole1
  type = Collimator_pinhole
  position = (3,0,0)
  rotation = (0,0,0)
  r_pin = 0.005  # baseline radius, will be optimized
  restore_neutron = 1
end

# Second pinhole collimator
collimator Pinhole2
  type = Collimator_pinhole
  position = (6,0,0)
  rotation = (0,0,0)
  r_pin = 0.005  # baseline radius, will be optimized
  restore_neutron = 1
end

# Sample component
sample Sample
  type = Sample_monodisperse_spheres
  position = (9,0,0)
  rotation = (0,0,0)
  radius = 0.01
  density = 1.0
  material = "Si"
  thickness = 0.005
  restore_neutron = 1
end

# Beamstop component
beamstop Beamstop
  type = Beamstop_circular
  position = (9,0,0)
  rotation = (0,0,0)
  radius = 0.05
  restore_neutron = 1
end

# Detector component
detector Detector
  type = Detector_2D
  position = (12,0,0)
  rotation = (0,0,0)
  xwidth = 60
  yheight = 60
  resolution = 0.01
  restore_neutron = 1
end

# Monitor to check the pattern width
monitor MonitorPattern
  type = Monitor_2D
  position = (12,0,0)
  rotation = (0,0,0)
  xwidth = 60
  yheight = 60
  restore_neutron = 1
end

# Link components in the beam path
Source -> Pinhole1 -> Pinhole2 -> Sample -> Beamstop -> Detector
Source -> MonitorPattern

# Define the parameters to optimize
parameter r_pin1 = 0.005 m
parameter r_pin2 = 0.005 m

# Run the simulation
run
  seed = seed
  ncount = ncount
  wait_s = 0
end

# Output the results
print "Chosen radii: r_pin1 = %f m, r_pin2 = %f m" r_pin1 r_pin2
print "Achieved intensity on detector: %f ± %f n/s" detector.intensity detector.err
print "Events: %d" detector.events
print "Measured dX: %f cm" MonitorPattern.dX
print "Rel_err: %f" MonitorPattern.rel_err
```
